title: Frutiger Aero Pod
theme_prompt: Quintessential FRUTIGER AERO (early-2000s glossy 'aqua' aesthetic): a translucent glossy media-player pod of clear aqua-blue and cyan GLASS with liquid highlights and water-droplet beads, brushed liquid-silver metal bezels, a lush grass-green glowing accent, crisp specular reflections and soft shadows, optimistic and clean. Think Windows-Vista-era glass, Apple-Aqua gel buttons, bubbles and water. Buttons are glossy gel jewels; the body is a smooth organic pebble. Vivid, saturated, dimensional — never flat, never grungy.
